BehaviorTree._description: Recovery after a stopped tracking run: activates joint_trajectory_admittance_controller (deactivating velocity_force_controller if it is active), so planned moves (Move to Waypoint, Move to Pose, ...) work again. Run it after you stop a continuous-tracking objective from the UI: a cancelled objective does not get to switch back itself. Does not move the arm. Safe to run when the trajectory controller is already active.

Action.message: Trajectory controller active; planned moves are available.
